title: Inspections tab columns: status, findings, work order, report and action
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Customers - View' and 'Work orders - View'; ShopCoach enabled.
  2. An asset with inspections in mixed states: some with Monitor/Not OK findings, some built (one where a WO was created, one where lines were added), some with nothing to do, some with reports. Seed by running inspections and building lines from some of them.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm the status column shows only the inspection's own progress, not whether work is pending.
2. Confirm the findings column shows one item per finding type with a colour (e.g. 1 Not OK red, 3 Monitor amber).
3. Confirm the work order column links to the run-on work order and shows its status; the report column links when a report exists.
4. Confirm the action column's three states: Needs action (offers the S6 build), Done (shows outcome, links to the work order, reads 'WO created' or 'Lines added'), Nothing to do (a dash).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The status column shows only the inspection's own progress, not whether work is pending.
  • The findings column shows one item per finding type with a colour, such as 1 Not OK in red and 3 Monitor in amber.
  • The work order column links to the work order the inspection was run on and shows its status.
  • The report column links to the report when one has been generated.
  • The action column has three states: Needs action (offers the S6 build), Done (shows the outcome and links to the work order, reading "WO created" or "Lines added"), and Nothing to do (a dash).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9103 (S5 — Inspection history on the asset record); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S5; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R5: “The status column will show the inspection's own progress only, and will not also express whether work is pending”
  • S5-R6: “The findings column will show one item per finding type with a colour, such as 1 Not OK in red and 3 Monitor in amber”
  • S5-R7: “The work order column will link to the work order the inspection was run on and show its status”
  • S5-R8: “The report column will link to the report when one has been generated”
  • S5-R9: “The action column will have three states. Needs action offers the build described in S6. Done shows the outcome and links to the resulting work order, reading "WO created" when a new work order was created and "Lines added" when the lines went onto the existing one. Nothing to do shows a dash”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
